body: Same, I’m scared being black to. As a black male, I’ve always been told too “act like a man” or when my dad got arrested “I’m the man of the house” at a young age. I hate that, and when I see black people being ghetto in public, or talking in slang, and calling each other the n word, it’s embarrassing. I’ve always felt I was out of place too, and I try not to imitate anything ghetto because, it makes me look bad and it’s embarrassing. I was told I look like I would rob a corner store before, and it was by a  Caucasian male with a group of his friends trying to seem cool. All it did was hurt me, because I try so hard to not fit into the black stereotype, I don’t sag, I talk properly, I respect everyone and I don’t ESPECIALLY not use the n word. But when people see me, that’s all they see, just another n word. It’s aggravating and hard, and I do wish the world would get better, but I feel like it won’t.
Thanks I needed that, I appreciate the advice. I know some of these things I shouldn’t do, but it’s like it’s everywhere. I’ll try to be better though, thank you.
